g.text: Tuned nested selector | Actual ROI rectangles in the oriented camera image
Each ROI: six held-out press recordings | Percentages give recordings equal weight
Left: correct ROI given true ROI. Right: contact detected given a positive press at that ROI.
Zoomed pixel layout; image y increases downward. Colors show evaluation recall, not optical intensity.
No-contact specificity is assessed separately; this map does not imply continuous spatial resolution.
